Text.Text: The range is clear of his school. Make every shot after this count for something. You've finished my One Shot trials. I have no further work for you here.
These range trials require rank 50 in Rifle. Reach it, then come back. A measured shot begins before you pull the trigger.

A crew in the Czerka range calls its wasteful shooting my doctrine. Recover its test docket so I can see what the instructors are rewarding. Defeat six One Shot Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the One Shot Czerka Test Docket; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office. I'll give you the Czerka Arms Test Range Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train One Shot.

Here's the Czerka Arms Test Range Key. Use '[Enter Czerka Weapons Testing Facility]' in Smuggler's Moon, Corporate District. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six One Shot Adepts, then return with the One Shot Czerka Test Docket.

A round is a promise. You spend it, something ends - the fight, the argument, the animal's pain. Spray, and you're a liar with a rifle. One breath, one round, one answer. That's the whole doctrine. It takes a lifetime.

Range crew. Czerka let them stay on when the contracts dried up, and they found my old target logs and decided doctrine was a thing you could copy off paper. Now they teach it loud and sell it louder. Six adepts on the near lanes. They count their hits. They never count their misses. That tells you everything.

The One Shot Czerka Test Docket. Their trial record - scores, groupings, round counts. I want the round counts. You can't shame a man with words on this moon; words are cheap here. Numbers, though. Numbers are honest.

Defeat six One Shot Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the One Shot Czerka Test Docket; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office.
You've defeated six One Shot Adepts. Let me see the One Shot Czerka Test Docket.
The training record is back. We can see what went wrong. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are running the blast-cell regulator for their own trials. Take it back. Defeat five One Shot Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the One Shot Blast-Cell Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Defeat five One Shot Specialists to secure the One Shot Blast-Cell Regulator, then return to me.

In volume. A specialist puts five rounds in the air hoping one lands honest, and against most people one does. Don't be most people. Between the third and fourth trigger pull there's a breath. Live inside it.

Overcharged cells flatten the arc and lie about range. Every shot feels like a gift - until the cell burns out mid-fight, or the barrel does, or the man does. The One Shot Blast-Cell Regulator kept those rifles honest for twenty years. They silenced it because honest rifles kept scoring them low.

I don't. Czerka is a ledger with a flag on it. But those lanes taught me my trade, and a rifle that lies raises liars. Someday somebody stands downrange of those students and pays for the lesson. I'd rather it was nobody.

Defeat five One Shot Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the One Shot Blast-Cell Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office.
You've defeated five One Shot Specialists. Let me see the One Shot Blast-Cell Regulator.
That equipment no longer serves their drills. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects the deeper firing lanes. Recover the range crest and end that defense. Defeat the One Shot Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the One Shot Scored Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility, use the '???' challenge marker to call the One Shot Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the One Shot Scored Range Crest.

I set the lane record the year that crest was struck. When I walked away, Czerka needed somebody to wear it for the clients, and he was the best still standing. He wore it so long he forgot the difference between the record and the man who set it. I don't want it back for the record. I want it back because everything it touches goes rotten on him.

Nine hundred meters. A crosswind that changes its mind three times along the way. Cover that works only until he's ranged it - which takes him one shot. That's why you bring eyes. A man can only be patient in one direction at a time.

Patience isn't armor. It's a bet that you break before he does. Three shooters who don't break, moving on separate breaths, and the bet's already lost. He'll know it, too. Around the second exchange he'll start spending rounds he meant to keep. That is the sound of a patient man dying. It sounds like hurry.

Defeat the One Shot Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the One Shot Scored Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the One Shot Warden. Let me see the One Shot Scored Range Crest.
The warden's watch is over. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four officers keep the crew's tests authorized. Bring me their clearance chit. Defeat four members of the One Shot Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the One Shot Czerka Clearance Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Defeat four members of the One Shot Inner Circle to secure the One Shot Czerka Clearance Chit, then return to me.

The One Shot Inner Circle fight together. Bring help if you can, and focus on one opponent at a time. Defeat four members to secure the One Shot Czerka Clearance Chit; simultaneous kills aren't required.

The One Shot Czerka Clearance Chit opens every gate, cage, and rack on the range. While they hold it, the range bleeds - gear out, strangers in. When you put it in my hand, the range closes. A range should have one gate and one keeper. I'm done pretending otherwise.

Eleven years of my rounds - wind, light, charge, pulse. A man's whole breath written down in numbers. In their hands it's a manual for counterfeiting me, sold by the page. Bring me the chit and they lose the armory it's locked behind. The logs I'll burn myself.

Defeat four members of the One Shot Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the One Shot Czerka Clearance Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office.
You've defeated four members of the One Shot Inner Circle. Let me see the One Shot Czerka Clearance Chit.
Their instructors no longer hold the authority to teach. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last shooter enforcing that doctrine. Defeat him in the Czerka Blast-Safe Cell. Defeat the One Shot Master in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Blast-Safe Cell. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Blast-Safe Cell, use the '???' challenge marker to call the One Shot Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Once. Nine hundred meters, one round each. Mine grazed his collar. His took the sling off my shoulder without breaking skin. We agreed, without one word, that the argument was settled and neither of us had won it. I left the moon. He stayed. That's the whole story, and you're the first person I've spent it on.

Because he stopped answering to anything. That crew hung his silence on every hit contract on this moon, and he let them - silence signs anything if you never spend words. A round is a promise, and he's forgotten who he was promising. What's left is just the shot, going wherever it's paid to go. The doctrine has to pass to somebody who still keeps the promise part. You, if you live.

You don't beat the shot. You spend it. Three of you means his first round buys him one target instead of the fight, and no man alive is reloading and untouchable in the same breath. That breath is the entire battle. Your eyes call it, your trigger closes it. He would tell you the same. He may yet - he talks to the ones who make it interesting.

Defeat the One Shot Master in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Blast-Safe Cell. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Shipyard Office; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the One Shot Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The range is clear of his school. Make every shot after this count for something. You've earned the right to train One Shot. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the job.
I'll defeat six One Shot Adepts.
What is your doctrine, then?
Who are they?
What's in the docket?
Not today.
Here's the One Shot Czerka Test Docket.
Back to the lanes.
I'll defeat five One Shot Specialists.
How do they shoot?
What does a hot rifle change?
Why do you care what Czerka's rifles do?
My barrel needs rest first.
Here's the One Shot Blast-Cell Regulator.
Back to the long lane.
I'll defeat the One Shot Warden.
How did he end up with your crest?
What makes the long lane different?
How does a patient man lose?
I don't have my eyes yet.
Here's the One Shot Scored Range Crest.
Back to the four.
I'll defeat four members of the One Shot Inner Circle.
What do these four do differently?
Why does the chit matter to you?
What's in the logs they're stripping?
Not until I've read the wind on this one.
Here's the One Shot Czerka Clearance Chit.
Back to the far lane.
I'll face the One Shot Master and report back.
You watched him shoot. Did you ever face him?
If he's the doctrine finished, why does he need to die?
How do we take a man who doesn't miss?
Not until every one of my eyes is ready.
The One Shot Master is defeated. Here's my report.
